redirect.text: Write the text `{{helloShell}}` to the file `~/{{helloFile}}` using `echo` and `>`.

append.text: Add another line to `~/{{helloFile}}` – without overwriting the first one.

count-errors.text: Count the number of lines containing `ERROR` in server.log by piping `grep` into `wc -l`.

uniq.text: Show how many times each fruit appears in `{{fruits}}`, using `sort` and `uniq -c`.

save-ls.text: Save a list of the files in `/etc` to the file `~/{{etcFiles}}`.

devnull.text: Run `ls /{{missing}}`, but send the error message to `/dev/null` so that nothing shows up.

xargs.text: Count the lines in every file in `~/{{documents}}`: find the files with `find -type f` and give them to `wc -l` with `xargs`.
xargs.hint: `find ~/{{documents}} -type f | xargs wc -l` – `wc` doesn't read file names from a pipe, but `xargs` turns them into arguments.
